name: @geo-content-os/worker-ai
description: GEO Content OS — AI Worker：Skill 编排、模型调用、生成运行

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-image build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-model-deepseek build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --pretty false
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-image build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-model-deepseek build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills build && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/contracts build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-image build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-storage build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/adapter-model-deepseek build && pnpm --filter @geo-content-os/skills build && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
